title: Stagwell (STGW) Appoints Nagmeh Taheri to Chief Growth Officer, Media & Commerce for Stagwell Europe
body_markdown:
Taheri brings over 25 years of experience driving growth across some of the world’s leading marketing holding companies, including WPP, Dentsu, Publicis Groupe, IPG and Omnicom. Widely recognised as one of the UK’s foremost new business leaders, Taheri was ranked No. 1 in Campaign’s UK Media New Business rankings in 2022 and 2024 and No. 3 in 2025. Throughout her career, she has built and led growth functions that have transformed how agency brands collaborate, compete and win, helping secure major media accounts including Aldi, L’Oréal, LVMH, NatWest and Sky. She also played a role in launching Local Planet in 2016, the global network of independent media agencies, helping create a compelling alternative to the traditional holding company model. Prior to this role, Taheri served as Chief Growth Officer, UK & Ireland at Omnicom Media.


The appointment follows a year of strong momentum across the Media & Commerce segment following last week’s[launch of Stagwell Media](https://pr.report/sei2) , the network’s new global media agency. The segment has also expanded its media capabilities through[The Media Machine](https://pr.report/sei3) as well as the launches of[Stagwell Search+](https://pr.report/sei4) and[Stagwell Curate](https://pr.report/sei5) by[Stagwell Media Platform](https://pr.report/sei6) earlier this year.


James Denton-Clark, Chief Growth & Client Officer of Stagwell Europe, said, “Europe is seeing more and more clients looking for integrated solutions that work seamlessly across markets, and that’s exactly where Nagmeh will make a difference. She has a brilliant track record of bringing teams together, raising the bar on how we go to market, and helping clients navigate complexity across multiple countries. As we continue to level up our focus on European multi-market opportunities, I’m excited to have her leading Stagwell’s regional media growth.”


Nagmeh Taheri, recently appointed Chief Growth Officer, Media & Commerce of Stagwell Europe, added, “What really drew me to Stagwell is its ambition, entrepreneurial spirit and willingness to do things differently. This is a moment of real change for our industry, and clients are increasingly looking for a more modern, connected alternative to traditional agency models. Stagwell is uniquely positioned to meet that need, bringing together creativity, media and technology in a way that reflects how brands need to grow today. I’m excited to join the team, build on the momentum, and use my experience to help drive the next phase of growth across Europe.”
